title: Aries Launches Stock Brokerage with Trading Rails for AI Agents
summary:
Users can now construct personalized investment dashboards via a modular interface that responds to natural language requests to generate new tools. The stock brokerage from Aries features an infinite canvas where traders drag and drop components, including Bloomberg TV and TradingView charts, across both desktop and mobile platforms.

The service provides dedicated trading rails for AI agents to accommodate the movement of the agent economy into retail brokerage accounts. The system operates on the finance.dev API and utilizes a proprietary Model Context Protocol to run its underlying infrastructure.
